Hello, 

The OkContract team has just released an open-source compiler, **osolc**, a Solidity compiler written in Zig. (https://x.com/VitalikButerin/status/2103455209322320022?s=20) 

The main goal is to make Solidity builds significantly faster, while keeping compatibility with existing Solidity workflows.

Our builds:
10 min → 2 min
Incremental large changes: 700s → 99s

Would love to get some feedback 

https://github.com/okcontract/oksolc
